notes.title: Playtest Now Available
notes.content: [p]Good news, everyone![/p][h1]New trailer and demo release on Oct 6[/h1][p]Firstly: the demo release is [b]confirmed[/b] for Oct 6 to coincide with the start of Finnish Games Week '25.[/p][p]The demo is packed with cool stuff:[/p][list][*][p]Quick 10-minute tutorial chapter[/p][/*][*][p]Chapters 1 and 2 from the full game[/p][/*][*][p][b]Seven[/b] postcard locations and [b]three[/b] characters from the full game[/p][/*][*][p]Extensive Tokyo train network covering 150+ years of Japanese railways[/p][/*][*][p]Endless mode where you can replay Chapter 2 with new characters, locations, and clues[/p][/*][/list][p]To celebrate this, there is a [b]new trailer[/b] which incorporates a lot of the new features and graphical upgrades over the last couple of months, so be sure to check that out if you have a minute.[/p][h1]Playtest is rolling out![/h1][p]Secondly: In preparation for the demo, the [b]playtest[/b] is now open![/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has already signed up for the playtest. There's still plenty of time to take part in the playtest if you don't want to wait for the demo: you can register your interest with the [b]Request Access[/b] button on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784300/Mysteries_of_Old_Tokyo/"]store page for Mysteries of Old Tokyo[/url]. I'll gradually add more and more playtesters from the queue over time.[/p][p]Some lucky playtesters will have already received access so please enjoy! Don't forget to send feedback if you come across a bug or something strange.[/p][p]That's everything for now. See you in October, and if you haven't already, don't forget to wishlist the game![/p]

notes.title: Playtest and demo on the way! Also: Finnish Games Week 2025
notes.content: [p]Welcome to the first installment of the [i]Mysteries of Old Tokyo[/i] devlog.[/p][h1]Playtest (September) and demo (TBD)![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655545/a028e965dcc6f26df32d5567c9023993b9d6fd38.png"][/img][/p][p]I had hoped August would be a productive month, and it was: [i]Mysteries of Old Tokyo[/i] now has a complete gameplay loop, improved graphics, sound effects, all-new travel options, and a [b]tutorial[/b].[/p][p]Because of that, I'm keen (and a little scared) to start getting your feedback! That's why I'm planning a [b]playtest sometime in September.[/b] As always, there are probably hundreds of things that I don't see, or have got used to, or simply never thought of.[/p][p]The playtest will [b]be held through Steam[/b] together with a Discord to collect feedback. If you're interested, just [b]follow[/b] for updates by clicking the [b]Follow button[/b] on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784300/Mysteries_of_Old_Tokyo/"]store page[/url], or keep an eye out on the socials:[/p][p][url="https://www.threads.com/@bolero_game" style="button" buttoncolor="#023164"]@bolero_game on Threads[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/bolerosoft.bsky.social" style="button" buttoncolor="#0673ea"]@bolerosoft on Bluesky[/url][/p][p]As well as the playtest, which will be open to everyone who wants to try, I'm hoping soon to release some kind of [b]demo[/b]? Ideally that will coincide with...[/p][p][/p][h1]Finnish Games Week 2025[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45655545/ffc5388f3edfcde56b1df4450265d72956786393.png"][/img][/p][p]I'm also excited to announce [i]Mysteries of Old Tokyo[/i] will be participating in the first-ever [b][url="https://www.finnishgamesweek.com/"]Finnish Games Week[/url] Steam Event[/b] from October 6-10! Kiitos paljon, och samma på svenska.[/p][p]As a happy resident of Finland for some years now, I'm really proud to be included in this event. As a country of just 5 million, Finland really punches above its weight in the game industry. [/p][p]In fact, one of the first things I ever learned about Finland was that [i]Max Payne [/i]was from Finland and this weird guy called Sam Lake made it. Perhaps you've played one of these Finnish games:[/p][list][*][p][i]Angry Birds[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Cities: Skylines[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Clash of Clans[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Alan Wake[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Brawl Stars[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Control[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]or even:[/p][list][*][p][i]Snake ([/i]Nokia 3310 ed.)[/p][/*][/list][p]and soon:[/p][list][*][p][i]Mysteries of Old Tokyo![/i][/p][/*][/list][p]If you haven't already, please remember to [b]wishlist the game by clicking the blue star over there[/b] (it costs nothing!) and if you're interested in trying the [b]playtest [/b]and [b]demo, [/b]you can [b]follow[/b] the game as well to get updates by clicking the [b]Follow[/b] button on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784300/Mysteries_of_Old_Tokyo/"]store page[/url].[/p][p]Thanks, and hope to have something for you soon![/p]
